messages:
Nina (SRE): Postmortem follow-up: we had three p95 spikes on text-gen in us-west this week. Pattern: KV-cache churn + a handful of giant batches. Need owners, short timelines, and a temporary SLO lane so customer pages stay stable.

Carlos: I see the same in traces. I'll own dashboard panels (per-pool p95 + request-size histogram) and tighten alerts. ETA Mon 11:30.

Mei: I'll try a conservative cache-retention bump and LRU config tweak. ETA Tue EOD.

Nina (SRE): Short emergency measure: 24h SLO lane where p95 target relaxes 200ms->255ms, pause noncritical rollouts during window, auto-rollback if extra error-budget burn >4%. Agree?

Carlos: Agree for 24h. I'll add an alert rule: sustained p95 delta >30ms for 15m -> page with runbook link.

ops-bot: ticket created: RED-9001 "us-west text-gen p95 - emergency SLO lane + caching". Canary scheduled on next deploy.

Mei: If tuning doesn't help, recommend enforcing max_batch=64 and per-pool throughput caps. I'll prepare a short experiment plan.

Nina (SRE): Owners recap: Carlos -> dashboards/alerts (Mon 11:30), Mei -> cache tuning + experiment plan (Tue EOD), Nina -> SLO lane PR + rollout gating (today). Reconvene Wed 09:30 to review telemetry and decide permanent SLO edits. Action items in RED-9001. :calendar:
